articles.body: 这篇讲依赖用了不合规的开源许可证时，怎么在合并前拦住。看完你可以在仓库 设置 → 安全 里打开许可证门禁和 未通过时拒绝合并 ，并到 AngusSecurity 策略里勾上 许可证合规 ，看允许名单和禁止名单在哪填。 仓库 xlliu/e2e-license-gate 的安全概览现在写着「许可证门禁未通过，拒绝合并」。许可合规页有两条开放发现，高危的 GPL-3.0-only 属于强互惠（分发软件时，要把相关代码也按同样的许可证公开），低危的 MIT 属于宽松（基本只要求保留版权声明）。 先登录 AngusGit，再打开仓库 xlliu/e2e-license-gate ；你自己的仓库也从登录后的仓库列表进入。安全扫描在团队版、企业版和云服务中提供；社区版没有 安全 菜单。开始前先让扫描跑起来：系统管理员打开 管理 → 安全设置 ，页面标题是 AngusSecurity 集成 ， 配置启用 为 已启用 、 平台可达 为 正常 ；还没开通时点 开通集成 。页面要求 angus.git.external-security.enabled=true 时，把环境变量 ANGUS_GIT_EXTERNAL_SECURITY_ENABLED 设为 true 并重启 AngusGit。仓库管理员再到该仓库 设置 → 安全 ，打开 本仓自动安全扫描 和 许可证合规 ，保存后提示「安全设置已保存」。对照本文时按仓库里已经保存的设置来看即可，不必再点 保存 、 立即扫描 或 立即执行 。 1.

articles.body: 这篇讲代码能推上 AngusGit 之后，怎么写一份让每次推送都自动构建和测试的 .anguscicd.yaml 。看完你可以写齐顶层字段，把多个 Job（流水线里的一组步骤）按顺序串起来，配好什么时候自动运行，并在脚本里引用凭证（平台上保存的令牌、密码），而不把令牌写进仓库文件。 开始之前先弄清三件事。这份文件用的是 AngusGit 自己的语法，和 GitLab CI 的 .gitlab-ci.yml 、GitHub Actions 的 workflow 文件都不通用。流水线功能只在团队版和企业版中提供，社区版没有 CI/CD 菜单。运行器（Runner，真正执行任务的机器）要先接好，否则推送之后任务会一直停在等待中。登录 AngusGit，侧栏进入 CI/CD → 运行器 ，点 新增 Runner 。 控制面地址 改成构建机访问得到的地址。名称写这台机器，例如 build-linux-01 。点 生成令牌 ，令牌 1 小时内有效，明文只显示一次。任务要在容器里跑时，页签选 Docker 一键拉起 ，标签填 linux,docker 。任务要直接在构建机上跑时，页签选 Zip 安装 ，标签不要带 docker ，机器上先装好 JDK 21。把命令复制到构建机执行，回到列表看到这台运行器是 空闲 ，再写 YAML。 下文的 YAML 都取自示例仓库 xlliu/test-cicd-example ，克隆地址是 https://git.anguskit.com/xlliu/test-cicd-example.git ，可以对照着看。文中用到仓库里的两份文件： .anguscicd/01-basic-build.yaml （ name: basic-build-test ）在控制台里显示为 test-cicd-example · 01 Basic Build ， .angus…

articles.body: 这篇讲在内网把 AngusGit 装起来之后，怎么确认团队真的能用。看完你可以在一台 Linux 上按安装向导装完，再用建仓、SSH 克隆、推送分支、合并拉取请求四步验收。拉取请求（Pull Request）是把一个分支的改动申请合进另一个分支的页面，同事可以在上面查看改动，确认后再合并。 验收里的 SSH 要先有公钥。本机还没有 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub 时，执行 ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com" ，保存路径直接回车，再执行 cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub ，复制以 ssh-ed25519 开头的一整行。登录 AngusGit 后，侧栏进入 我的 → SSH密钥 ，点 添加SSH密钥 ，标题自定，粘贴这一行，点 添加密钥 。地址里的用户名固定是 git ，端口是 2222。想改用 HTTPS 时，到 我的 → 访问令牌 点 生成新令牌 ， 密码验证 填登录密码，勾选 git:write ，仓库权限设为 WRITE ，生成后马上复制。推送时用户名填登录名，密码填这把令牌。 AngusGit 的私有化安装包自带一个交互式向导，在一台内网 Linux 服务器上按提示选几项、填几项就能装完。向导里要选定安装方式、访问方式和数据库，日常则要把数据库和仓库目录一起备份。下文以社区版（最多 10 个用户）为例；团队版和企业版的安装步骤相同，只是需要额外提供许可证文件。 1.

articles.title: What happens when you enter a URL in your browser?
articles.excerpt: You type dev.to, press Enter, and the page is there in about a second. It feels instant, so we never think about it. But a lot happens in that small gap, and it is worth knowing, because this one ques…
articles.body: You type dev.to , press Enter, and the page is there in about a second. It feels instant, so we never think about it. But a lot happens in that small gap, and it is worth knowing, because this one question quietly covers DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP and how browsers paint pixels. Let us go through it step by step. Everything below comes from a real test run against dev.to , and every command is included, so you can run the same checks on any site you like. Step 1: The browser reads the URL Before any network work, the browser parses what you typed. A URL like https://dev.to/some-article has three parts: the scheme ( https ), the host ( dev.to ) and the path ( /some-article ). The scheme tells the browser which port to use by default. HTTPS means port 443, plain HTTP means port 80.

articles.title: Vetal PR : I Gave Git a Ghost. It Won't Let Me Push Until I Explain My Own Diff.
articles.excerpt: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 4: Ghost in the Machine If you grew up in India, you probably know this story even if you never read it. A king named Vikram wa…
articles.body: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 4: Ghost in the Machine What I Built If you grew up in India, you probably know this story even if you never read it. A king named Vikram walks into a cremation ground at night, climbs a tamarind tree, and cuts down a corpse. A ghost lives in that corpse: Vetal . Vikram slings him over his shoulder and starts walking, and Vetal starts talking. He tells a story. Every story ends in a riddle. And every riddle comes with the same warning: "If you know the answer and keep silent, your head will burst into a thousand pieces." Vikram always knows. So he speaks, and the moment he breaks his silence, Vetal laughs and flies back to the tree. Twenty-five stories. Twenty-five walks back to the tree.

articles.body: Mapping Apache NiFi data-flow interfaces before changing access policy Apache NiFi sits on the path between data sources, transformations, and destinations. That position makes its user interface and REST API more than a monitoring convenience. They can expose flow definitions, processor configuration, connection metadata, and operational controls. An inventory is useful when it distinguishes an observed NiFi interface from a confirmed anonymous or vulnerable deployment. Why the interface matters NiFi's administration guide describes authenticated access, authorization policies, and the nifi.security.allow.anonymous.authentication setting. A secured instance does not allow anonymous authentication unless that property is enabled.

articles.excerpt: It's still unknown how attackers got access to Anthropic's verified Cursor account.
articles.body: An official extension for Anthropic’s Claude model was backdoored and threatened as many as 5,000 developers' machines, multiple sources reported Friday. Anthropic so far has yet to warn customers of the incident. The compromised package was a VS Code extension available in the marketplace of Cursor, a maker of AI-assisted developer tools, the company said Friday. The malicious version, 2.1.313, subsequently affected “at most 5,000 users,” presumably when they either downloaded it or their systems automatically fetched and installed it. Anthropic pushed version 2.1.314 several hours after the previous version became available on Cursor, according to independent researcher Kevin Beaumont.

articles.title: An aquanaut comes home: Returning to Earth from an undersea 'space station'
articles.excerpt: After five days of living underwater, Analog Astronaut Commander Dr. Musilova and her crew return to terra firma, affected by higher pressures and the team's disconnection from home.
articles.body: Our time on our "space mission" underwater was coming to an end, and I felt like what I imagine an astronaut on the International Space Station (ISS) must feel before returning to Earth. On one hand, you are excited to return to your home and loved ones, as well as to fresh food and normal hygiene. On the other, you know you will miss your crew and the incredible experience of being in space. While my SEA STAR crew and I had not left Earth during our mission, we were separated from the surface of our home planet for five days. All we saw was a green alien water world surrounding us. We did this to live and work like astronauts on the ISS .

articles.title: India launches next-gen navigation satellite to orbit (video)
articles.excerpt: India launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite to orbit today (Oct. 30) atop a GSLV rocket. It was the fourth orbital launch from Indian soil so far this year.
articles.body: India bolstered its homegrown satellite-navigation system today (Oct. 30). A GSLV Mark II rocket launched the nation's NVS-03 satellite from Satish Dhawan Space Centre today at 2:21 p.m. EDT (1821 GMT and 11:51 p.m. India Standard Time). Everything went well: The rocket deployed NVS-03 into geostationary transfer orbit as planned, officials with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) announced on X about 30 minutes after liftoff. An Indian GSLV Mark II rocket launches the NVS-03 navigation satellite on Oct. 30, 2026. (Image credit: ISRO) NVS-03 is the third next-gen satellite that India has launched for the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC), its version of the United States' Global Positioning System ( GPS ).

In celebration of Halloween , we're running down some horror franchises that made the journey to the final frontier, resulting in films that range from the sublime and outrageously campy fun to just pure awful. Absent from the list are space horror movies that have space baked into their natural fabric.
